question: In a Windows Operating System, what is the short cut key for undoing a task?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Z**__.

__
 
• **Ctrl + Z is the shortcut key for undoing a task**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Undo is a **function performed to reverse the action of earlier action**.
 
• Any **actions that were previously undone using the Undo function are restored using the Redo function**.
 
• For example, if you entered a word and then used the undo function to remove it, the redo function would restore the erased word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Shortcut keys**__
 
 

 __**Tools Name**__
 __**Keyboard Operation**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 Undo
 Ctrl + Z
 Reverses the last command.
 
 

 Redo
 Ctrl + Y
 Reverses the action of the Undo button.
 
 

 Copy
 Ctrl + C
 Copies the selected item to the clipboard.
 
 

 Paste
 Ctrl + V
 Places the content of the clipboard at the insertion point.
 
 

 Cut
 Ctrl + X
 Removes the selection from the document and place it on the clipboard.
